items.title: AI-powered anomaly detection for AWS Systems Manager Session Manager logs using Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: When an operations engineer or developer starts an AWS Systems Manager Session Manager session on a managed node, every command they run is captured as a transcript. Any one of those commands is either routine work or the first sign of a security incident. At scale, with hundreds of nodes generating thousands of command entries […]
